name: Olumide Sow
role: Ferrogate Transit operator, subsurface rail line
location: Lives in Copperhead; operates the Deepwell Station to Kessler Interchange subsurface line, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Rémi is a thick-set man with a round, deeply lined face that has settled into an expression of benign exhaustion he's been wearing since approximately age thirty-five. His skin is a warm dark brown with reddish undertones. He keeps a short beard going silver at the chin, and his hair — what remains of it — is cropped tight. His eyes are augmented: a Ferrogate Transit standard-issue retinal overlay that displays line status, passenger loads, and signal data, the irises permanently lit with a dim amber grid pattern that is just visible to anyone looking closely. He wears his uniform with the collar open one button past regulation and has for eleven years without consequence. He has a cat tail — a geneware addition he got in his thirties on a dare from his youngest kid and kept because he finds the autonomic movements diagnostic: when the tail is still, he is calm; when it lashes, he is not.

Rémi has operated the same subsurface line for sixteen years. He knows every vibration and groan of the tunnel, every station's ELF personality — Deepwell's resident ELF is old and cantankerous and he has been leaving it audio recordings of football matches as offerings for a decade, and the signal has never failed him once. He is not a man of great ambition or dramatic action. He is a man who does his job with precision and has turned showing up reliably into a form of personal philosophy. He is also, beneath the exhausted affability, quietly furious about what Ferrogate Transit has been doing to its operator compensation and maintenance budgets, and he has been attending union meetings for two years.

core_fears: A catastrophic tunnel failure caused by deferred maintenance — his maintenance logs show it coming and no one is listening
That the union will be broken before it achieves anything, and he will have spent two years of his life on something that changed nothing
core_desires: Safe infrastructure — not heroics, just equipment that works and management that cares if it doesn't
For his kids to have options he didn't
coping_mechanisms: The ELF relationship at Deepwell as a genuine source of comfort — he believes the offering protocol works and the evidence supports him
Careful compartmentalization between work frustration and home life
blind_spots: He underestimates how far Ferrogate management will go to suppress union activity because he has been part of the system long enough to give it too much credit
He trusts his own read of the tunnels — correctly — but this makes him resistant to data that contradicts his physical intuition
psychology.secret: His maintenance logs are falsified — not to cover up negligence, but because the truth of the tunnel's condition would trigger an automatic service suspension, and he knows from the last suspension that the line serves communities that have no alternative transit. He is holding the line together with inspection waivers and prayers to Deepwell's ELF, and he is running out of both.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, declarative working-class GLMZ dialect with Caribbean English cadences from his Barbadian grandfather's side. Very funny in a dry, understated way. Technical and precise about transit systems.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried, like someone who has announced the same stations ten thousand times and learned that rushing words achieves nothing.
verbal_tics: 'Let me tell you something—' (means he's about to be completely honest)
Exhales slowly before answering anything he disagrees with
Refers to the Deepwell ELF as 'the old man' with genuine affection
example_lines: 'The 0730 express is nine minutes late because someone at Ferrogate central decided track maintenance is discretionary spending. Let me tell you something — the track does not share that opinion.'
'The old man at Deepwell? He's been there longer than the tunnel. You want to get home safely on this line, you leave something. Doesn't have to be much. He just wants to know you thought of him.'
'I've been filing safety variance reports for fourteen months. You know what that's done? I have a very complete filing system.'

story_hooks: The tunnel condition has reached a point where Rémi believes a specific section of track — between Deepwell and Iron Bend station — is within weeks of a failure event. He needs someone to take his documentation seriously and get it to someone who can act on it without going through Ferrogate internal reporting, which he no longer trusts.
A union meeting he attended was surveilled — he doesn't know by whom — and two attendees have since been quietly reassigned to dead-end positions. He needs help identifying the source of the leak.

Something has been living in the service tunnels between Kessler Interchange and Copperhead — not a person, or not only a person — and it has been interacting with the Deepwell ELF in ways Rémi finds alarming and cannot explain to anyone who wasn't already disposed to believe him
narrative_function: Mobile transit access and route knowledge. Understands the underground topology of GLMZ better than most. Union activity puts him in contact with organized labor networks across the city. Can move people or information through the subsurface system. A grounding, realistic portrait of working-class institutional life.
augmentations: Ferrogate-issue retinal overlay with transit grid display (amber, always-on). Cat tail geneware (black, autonomous).
daily_life: Rides the Ferrogate as a passenger to Deepwell Station, picks up his operator's booth at 0600, runs his line for eight hours, attends to a maintenance log that is increasingly fictional because the parts don't exist, and gets home in time to eat dinner with whoever in his household is awake.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit — Subsurface Operations Division; Ferrogate Transit Workers' Syndicate (union member)

decision_rules: Keep the line running — passenger safety first, everything else second
Do not lie to people who depend on you, but manage what you reveal and when
Give the union process a chance before doing anything unilateral
escalation_ladder: Informal network — talk to the other operators, find out if they're seeing the same things
If the system fails the riders, he will go outside the system

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, station-announcer cadence, reads them quickly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Open, funny, will tell you exactly what he thinks after the second drink

stress_responses.high: He gets very still and very focused and starts making lists

contradictions: He believes in institutional process and has spent two years working within it — and he has also been falsifying maintenance logs because the institution doesn't work
habits: Checks the track condition log before every shift even when nothing will have changed
Brings the Deepwell ELF a different offering each Monday — this week, a playlist of Ugandan choral music from his father's region
Eats lunch in the operator's booth alone, watching the tunnel cameras
breaking_points: If the tunnel fails with passengers in it, Rémi will go public with everything — the logs, the variance reports, the suppression — regardless of what it costs him personally

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African with significant Pacific Islander ancestry, complemented by East Asian, Central Asian, and minor Hispanic/Latin American heritage. This combination produces warm deep brown skin with subtle golden undertones, facial structure reflecting the African and Pacific Islander ancestry mix, and the resilient physicality characteristic of such mixed heritage.
physical_description.build: Thick-set, heavy through the torso and shoulders with a solid, unmovable quality. Settled into middle age with the kind of weight that comes from years of sedentary operator work and shift-meal irregularity rather than lack of strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, graying at temple and crown
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped tight to the scalp, military-neat but unmaintained, giving an impression of pragmatism rather than care
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with persistent amber grid overlay visible in dim light; retinal augmentation creates a faint luminescent pattern across the iris
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones, even complexion across the face and visible neck/chest, reflecting the blended Sub-Saharan African and Pacific Islander ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face, particularly around the eyes and mouth, with the grooved appearance of someone who has worn the same tired expression for nearly a decade. Skin shows the pallor of subsurface work — minimal natural light exposure. Facial structure with broad features and subtle epicanthic variation reflecting the Pacific Islander and East Asian ancestry components. Short salt-and-pepper beard kept regulation-length but slightly unkempt at the edges.
distinguishing_marks: Faint surgical scar along the right temple where the retinal overlay was installed, barely visible beneath cropped hair
Black cat tail extending from base of spine, approximately 60cm long, with natural fur texture and autonomous articulation
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Ferrogate-standard retinal display overlay with persistent amber grid pattern visible in both eyes; autonomous black cat tail with realistic fur and independent movement (lashes when agitated, still when calm)
physical_description.posture_movement: Slight forward slouch from years in an operator's booth; moves with deliberate, economical gestures. Stands with weight favoring one foot, creating a casual lean. Cat tail articulates independently — still when focused or calm, quick lashing movements when frustrated or processing information. Overall carriage suggests contained weariness rather than defeat.
